Chapter 623: Chapter 42 I’ve Waited Too Long (Please Subscribe)_2

But the essence of the core was much the same.

“Time…” Lin Yuan was nearly obsessed, carefully feeling the operation of the Rule of Time within the Miniature Universe.

[Your comprehension defies the heavens, watching the essence of time accelerates your understanding of the Rule of Time…]

…

Several hours later, Lin Yuan struggled to free himself from the state of Enlightenment.

“This Miniature Universe, for me, surpasses all Secret Treasure Weapons,” Lin Yuan murmured to himself.

...

The Miniature Universe hardly had any offensive or defensive capabilities, but it allowed for a certain balance of many rules to form.

This was of great help for the future transformation of the Inner World into an Inner Universe, which would be completely independent of the Main Universe.

Transforming the Inner World into an Inner Universe is one of the thresholds for becoming a Supreme Being.

Why a Supreme Being could exist eternally was because of the Inner Universe.

The Inner Universe existed independently, with its own River of Time, allowing the Supreme Being to step out of the River of Time of the Main Universe, achieving eternity for the Physical Soul and Spirit Will.

“Moyu Tower Master…” Lin Yuan increasingly admired the Moyu Tower Master.

Although this Miniature Universe was far from a Supreme Being’s Inner Universe, it was a perfect replica of it.

It allowed the existence under the Supreme Being to glimpse certain sceneries of the Ultimate Realm.

“Continue to ponder,” he said.

Lin Yuan rested for a while, then took out the Miniature Universe again and observed it seriously.

…

Time passed.

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit finally arrived at the core area.

Boom… Boom… Boom…

The multiple Spatial Layers trembled, and ultimately, a figure appeared.

It was Lin Yuan.

“Finally here.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. From entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to reaching the core area, it had taken nearly thirty years in total.

This did not include the time when Lin Yuan ended his ninth traversal, with his strength greatly increased, speeding up his journey.

From the periphery of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to the core area, it would take more than twenty years, and then traveling back to the periphery to wait for expulsion from the Secret Realm also required twenty years.

A round trip took fifty years.

“The gains along the way…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Inner World, where a heap of ‘Xuanhuang Crystals’ and many treasures and weapons were placed.

Although Lin Yuan did not deliberately seek out hostile Ninth Rank Alien Races on the way, he occasionally encountered them, and once he did, they basically could not escape, even the special Ninth Rank ones.

Added to that, some native lives that weren’t afraid to die, made Lin Yuan’s gains exceed eight million Cubic Universe Crystals.

“It’s only in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm that I could have this opportunity…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

First, only Ninth Rank lives were allowed to enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. If it were outside, on the Battlefields of Different Races, an existence like Lin Yuan would definitely be targeted by special Tenth Rank Life or a Ninth Rank Life holding a Tier 11 Secret Treasure.

They would never allow Lin Yuan to kill indiscriminately.

Secondly, many Alien Strong Ones on the Battlefields of Different Races would not carry any precious treasures. Although the numerous Ninth Rank Alien Races in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would also not carry any precious treasures, the opportunities found within the Secret Realm were very real.

It was as if the Ninth Rank Alien Races that died at the hands of Lin Yuan had worked for him from the start.

“The calling is getting stronger.”

Lin Yuan carefully felt it. After entering the core area, the sense of calling had increased significantly.

However, other than the vague sounds of “Xuanhuang Emperor,” Lin Yuan could not distinguish anything else.

“That direction.”

Lin Yuan determined the source based on the sense of calling and immediately headed towards it.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm, core area.

In front of an ancient and mysterious palace.

Several figures with suppressed auras stood in place.

These figures were all early-arriving Ninth Rank strong beings, capable of traversing thousands of Spatial Layers to directly enter the core area—a feat of special Ninth Rank beings.

“This palace suddenly appeared; it wasn’t here before,” a Ninth Rank Alien Race being with dark golden scales said with a heated gaze.

The core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, each opportunity was infused with the most precious treasures, generally surpassing those of the inner and outer zones, and this palace had never appeared before.

A palace that had never been seen before appearing abruptly meant that everyone, especially the special Ninth Rank figures present, realized that the palace contained a great opportunity.

“Indeed, there is no record of this palace in the annals of my race,” another special Ninth Rank said after careful observation, speaking up as well.

He came from a peak clan with detailed intelligence about the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; records of numerous places of opportunity were kept, but this palace before him was the first he had seen.

“But how shall we get in?” a third Special Ninth Rank spoke up.

Any clear-eyed person knew that this palace contained great opportunities, but even the greatest opportunity would be useless unless one managed to enter. To be blocked outside the palace, staring with wide eyes, was worse than never having seen it at all.

“This palace can completely withstand our attacks, so forcing our way in seems hopeless,” the golden-scaled Special Ninth Rank that spoke first frowned.

Upon discovering the palace, he had intended to force his way in, but it was futile; his most powerful strike upon the palace elicited no response whatsoever.

“Could it be that entering this palace requires certain conditions?” another Special Ninth Rank suggested, as some locations of opportunity in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm were indeed marked by specific entry conditions.

However, those conditions were generally common and hints were usually given outside the palaces.

As the several Special Ninth Ranks continued to observe the palace,

Hum.

Subtle vibrations arose from the deep layers of space.

“Hmm?”

The countenances of the Special Ninth Ranks shifted.

“Who is it?”

The golden-scaled Special Ninth Rank looked serious.

“The Galaxy Master.”

“The Galaxy Master is coming here,”

remarked a Special Ninth Rank, his face grim.

Information regarding the Galaxy Master was something nearly all Ninth Rank powerhouses within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm were aware of in recent times.

These Special Ninth Ranks, naturally, had long heard of him.

The Galaxy Master was a monster that had the capability to kill Special Ninth Rank beings.

Such an entity was exceedingly rare in any era.

“What should we do?”

“The Galaxy Master is clearly heading for this palace.”

A few of the Special Ninth Ranks exchanged hesitant glances.

“Let’s go.”

“We can’t stay here,”

After a brief internal struggle, one by one, the Special Ninth Ranks quickly left.

They were very eager for the opportunities within the mysterious ancient palace, but they feared the Galaxy Master even more.

Even without the mysterious palace, they could still garner considerable gains within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but if they were to die at the hands of the Galaxy Master because of the palace,

it would all be for naught.

Especially for those few Special Ninth Ranks that didn’t have a good relationship with human civilization, they left without any hesitation.

The others, when encountering the Galaxy Master, whether or not they would die was a matter of luck; if the Galaxy Master was in a good mood, they might just survive.

But for them…approaching the Galaxy Master all but guaranteed death.

Before long,

The exterior of the mysterious ancient palace

was empty of any presence.

Swoosh.

The next moment,

Lin Yuan’s figure silently appeared.

“They’ve all run away?”

Lin Yuan glanced in the direction where the Special Ninth Ranks had fled.

If it had been before, he might have been inclined to give chase since every Special Ninth Rank, in Lin Yuan’s eyes, was a moving land of opportunity.

But now…

“Is the calling sensation coming from this palace?” Lin Yuan observed the palace carefully.

The palace’s aura was mysterious and ancient, crossing multiple spatial layers; its main body should reside within a certain layer, whereas the palace in front of him was likely just the entrance to the true palace.

“How to get in?” Lin Yuan did not act but continued his observation.

Based on the behavior of those Special Ninth Ranks lingering outside the palace just moments ago, Lin Yuan deduced that they were unable to force their way in.

…

Just as Lin Yuan appeared outside the palace,

a will deep within the palace began to awaken, observing Lin Yuan who stood outside with an excited expression.

“I have waited for dozens of Cosmic Eras, and at last, a young one capable of inheriting His Majesty’s mantle has arrived.”
